n-k-k9-01.title: Musoro unotaura zvakawanda kupfuura ongororo here?
n-k-k9-01.goal: Enzanisa musoro wenhau nenhamba dzeongororo dziri munyaya, sarudza kuti mazwi api emusoro anopfuura humbowo, uye unyore musoro usingapfuuri.
n-k-k9-01.material:
Nzvimbo yenhau yemuno yakaparidza nyaya iyi.

[제목] 주민 대다수, 공원 야간 개방에 찬성

[본문] 구청이 지난 3일 공원 이용객 50명에게 설문한 결과, 야간 개방에 찬성한 사람은 28명이었다. 반대는 15명, 모르겠다는 응답은 7명이었다. 설문은 낮 시간에 공원 입구에서만 진행됐다. 구청은 "주민 전체의 의견으로 보기는 어렵다"며 추가 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.1: Kucherekedza mazwi ehuwandu (대다수, 과반) nemazwi eboka (주민, 이용객)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuverenga nyaya pfupi yenhau mumutauro wakanyorwa (-했다, -밝혔다)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.1: Unoziva mazwi 찬성/반대, 설문, 응답, 절반
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.prompt: Enzanisa musoro nenhamba dziri mumuviri. Mazwi api emusoro anopfuura zvinoratidzwa neongororo? Sarudza ese anoshanda.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti ndiani akabvunzwa, kupi nerinhi, uchishandisa mazwi emuviri chete.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.1: Shandura 28 kubva pa 50 kuita mugove, wobva wabvunza kuti mugove uyu unokodzera izwi rehuwandu remusoro here.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.c: Kutsigira ndiko chaizvo chakataurwa nevanhu 28, saka izwi iri rinotsigirwa nenhamba.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.d: Kuvhura usiku ndicho chinyorwa chemubvunzo weongororo, saka izwi iri rinotsigirwawo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.explain: Vashanyi vepaki vakapfuura pamusuwo masikati chete ndivo vakabvunzwa, saka '주민' rakafara kupfuura humbowo. 28 pa 50 ndi 56 muzana, pamusoro zvishoma pehafu, izvo zvisiri '대다수'. '찬성' ne '야간 개방' zvinoenderana neongororo.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.0: Boka rinopfuura chaizvo (nyaya yacho pachayo inozvitaura). Tarisawo kuti 대다수 ine simba rakadini kune 28 pa 50.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.1: Izwi resimba rinopfuura chaizvo. Tarisawo kuti ndiani akabvunzwa chaizvo: vashanyi chete panzvimbo imwe nenguva imwe.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa musoro mumwe nemumwe pazvinhu zviviri: boka nenhamba.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga zvakare mugove wesarudzo inoshandisa muzana rakasiyana.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvichiri kuti 주민, boka risina kuvharwa neongororo, kunyange 과반 inoenderana nemugove.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.c: 70 muzana inosanganisa vanhu 28 vanotsigira nevanhu 7 vakapindura 'handina chokwadi'; 56 muzana chete ndivo vakati vanotsigira.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.d: 28 vanotsigira nemakanga 15 vanopikisa haisi kupatsanurwa kwakaenzana, uye 주민 rakafara zvakare.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.explain: 28 pa 50 ndi 56 muzana, uye vanhu vakabvunzwa vaiva vashanyi vepaki. Musoro unotaura zvose boka nenhamba.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora musoro MUMWE mutsva (mutsetse mumwe wechiKorea) unozivisa ongororo iyi usingapfuuri.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga neboka rakabvunzwa, wobva wataura nhamba kana mugove, wobva wataura chiito 찬성.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.1: Siya izwi ripi neripi rakafara kana rine simba kupfuura zvaunogona kuverenga.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Muverengi anogona kuziva kuti ndiani akapindura ongororo here?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nhamba iri musoro wangu ndiyo yandinogona kuverenga kubva mumuviri here?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Izwi ripi neripi rinoita kuti mugumisiro unzwike wakasimba kupfuura 56 muzana yevashanyi 50 here?

n-k-k9-03.title: Ndiani anogona kujoina kamba yecoding?
n-k-k9-03.topic: Miganhu mumitemo: 이상, 이하, 초과, 미만 (gadzira mhinduro dzakawanda)
n-k-k9-03.goal: Verenga zviziviso zvine mazwi emiganhu, tsvaga kuti mitengo ipi inobvumirwa, gadzira mabhoka akati wandei anosangana nemitemo yese panguva imwe chete, uye uzivise rimwe muchiKorea.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.0: Kuverenga mazwi emiganhu (이상, 이하, 초과, 미만) nemazvo
n-k-k9-03.thinking.1: Kuwana mugumisiro wakavanzika (mari inogumira hukuru hweboka)
n-k-k9-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakarurama dzakawanda uye kutarisa imwe neimwe
n-k-k9-03.prereq.1: Unoziva 만 ~세 (zera repasi rose) ne 명
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.prompt: Zvirevo zvipi zvinobvumirwa neziviso? Sarudza zvese zvinoshanda.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa mutsetse wenhamba uye uratidze nhamba imwe neimwe yemuganhu seiri mukati kana isiri mukati.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti izwi rinoreva 'kusanganisira nhamba iyi' kana 'kupfuura nhamba iyi'.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kuti 미만 inoitei kunhamba pachayo: 'pasi pe 19' haisanganise 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.c: Mari yeboka ye 20,000 won chaiyo yaizova yakanaka.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.c: Tarisa kuti 초과 inoitei kunhamba pachayo: 'pamusoro pe 20,000' haisanganise 20,000.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.d: Mari yeboka ye 30,000 won chaiyo yaizova yakanaka.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.explain: 이상 ne 이하 zvinosanganisira nhamba pachayo; 초과 ne 미만 hazvisanganise. Saka 14 iri mukati, 19 iri kunze, 20,000 iri kunze uye 30,000 iri mukati.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mabhoka 3 akasiyana anosangana nemitemo yese. n = huwandu hwenhengo, y = zera renhengo diki, o = zera renhengo yakura (makore akazara).
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga mari yenhengo 3, 4 ne 5 usati wasarudza mazera.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza zera idiki kutanga, wobva wasarudza rakura mukati memakore 3 uye pasi pe 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhengo diki iri pasi pe 만 14세.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhengo yakura inofanira kuva pasi pe 만 19세, saka 19 hairatidzwi.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Nhengo yakura haigoni kuva diki kupfuura diki.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Mari yeboka iri pamusoro pe 20,000 uye isingapfuuri 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Mari yeboka (7,000 x nhengo) inofanira kupfuura 20,000 uye isingapfuuri 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.explain: Mutemo wemari unobvumira nhengo 3 chete (21,000 won) kana nhengo 4 (28,000 won), kunyange mutemo weboka uchiti kusvika 5. Mazera anofanira kuramba ari pakati pe 14 ne 18 nemusiyano usingapfuuri 3.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza rimwe REBOKA rako uye unyore meseji pfupi yekunyoresa kumurongi muchiKorea (mutauro une rukudzo): huwandu hwenhengo, mazera enhengo diki nenhengo yakura, nemari yose.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Shandisa mutsara umwe weboka rako: nhamba nhatu.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora nhengo, wobva wanyora mazera, wobva wanyora mari, uchipedzisa mutsara mumwe nemumwe nerukudzo.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dziri mumeseji yangu dzinoenderana neboka rimwe randakagadzira here?
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Mari yose ndi 7,000 won yakawedzerwa nehuwandu hwenhengo here?

n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
n-k-k9-04.goal: Verenga mutsara mumwe sezvo mamiriro akawanda achisvika, cherekedza kuti revo inotama sei pakati pekurumbidza nemhoshoro, uye upindure shoko remhoshoro nerukudzo.
n-k-k9-04.material: Muvhuro mangwanani. Boka renyu rine musangano wevhiki. Unopinda mukamuri uye 팀장님 (mutungamiriri weboka) anotaura mutsara mumwe kwauri. Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe, sarudza kuverenga kunoita sekwakanyanya, wobva waenderera.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuverenga kana zvokwadi zvitsva zvasvika
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe usarudze revo inonyanya kuita yemutsara wa팀장님 usati waenderera.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti zvokwadi zvipi nezvenguva nemaitiro emutauri zvaizoita kuti mazwi ave echokwadi kana asiri.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: 팀장님 anonyanya kuita chii nemutsara uyu?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Pasina mamiriro zvose kuverenga kuviri kunogoneka: '참 ...도' inogona kuratidza kufarira chaiko kana kuwedzera kwemhoshoro. Mazwi oga haasarudze.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hapana chiri mumutsara chinokumbira shanduko yemune ramangwana; chikumbiro chaizoshandisa pendero senge -아 주세요.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Wakataura zvinopesana nechokwadi (kare kana maminetsi 40 anonoka), pasina kunyemwerera: iyi mhoshoro. Mudzidzi anongodudzira mazwi chete aizotadza kutsvaga kunzwisa.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Musangano wakatotanga maminetsi 40, saka hapana angakurumbidze zvechokwadi kusvika uku.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Mutauri haabvunzi chinhu; kutarisa wachi kunonongedzera mashoko.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Neruzivo rutsva urwu, mutsara wa팀장님 unoreva chii?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Zvokwadi zvino zvinoenderana nemashoko, saka mutsara unorehwa zvakananga (pamwe nehuchenjeri). Nyaya inogona kugadzira kushoropodza uye kuubvisawo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Nemusangano pa10:30 uri maminetsi 50 nekukurumidza, saka hapana kunonoka kunoshoropodzwa.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hapana chiratidzo chedzakadaro; kofi nekunyemwerera zvinoratidza hushamwari.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Mutsara hausi mubvunzo uye chizivisiro hachitaurwi mairi.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.reflect: Mazwi haana kuchinja; zvokwadi ndizvo zvakachinja. Kana mutsara uchitaura chinhu chisingaenderani nezvokwadi (pano, 'early' kumunhu anonoka), muteereri anochiverenga sekushoropodza (반어). Zvokwadi zvitsva zvinogonawo kubvisa kuverenga uku zvakare.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Dzokera kuchikamu chechipiri: musangano wakatanga pa9:00 uye wakasvika pa9:40. Pindura 팀장님 nekutaura kwemutsa, uchipindura zvinorehwa nemashoko aya chaizvo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekutumidza zvawakaita zvisina kururama mumutsara mumwe pfupi.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro yangu inoratidza kuti ndakanzwisisa mashoko aya sekushoropodza here?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Chikonzero changu kana chivimbiso ndechimwe chinhu mushandi mumwe angagamuchira here?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ndaizotaura nenzira iyi ku팀장님 yangu (nemutsa, kwete kuzvidzivirira) here?

n-k-k9-02.title: Chibatanidzi chinoshandura nharo
n-k-k9-02.goal: Tsvaga mutsara une chibatanidzi chinonongedzera nharo nenzira isina kururama, sarudza chibatanidzi chinodzorera kufunga, uye unyore patsva mutsara.
n-k-k9-02.material: Mudzidzi akanyora ndima pfupi nezvekushanda kumba kumagazini yechikoro. Chibatanidzi chimwe hachienderani nemafungiro.
n-k-k9-02.thinking.0: Kuverenga zvibatanidzi sezviratidzo zvenzira (kuwedzera, kupesana, mugumisiro)
n-k-k9-02.prereq.1: Unogona kuverenga mitsara pfupi yemutauro wakanyorwa (-다)
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara une izwi rekutanga rinopesana nenzira yenharo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.0: Taura nemazwi ako basa romutsara mumwe nemumwe mundima, wobva wacherechedza kuti izwi rawo rekutanga rinoubatanidza sei nemutsara wapfuura.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.1: Pachibatanidzi chimwe nechimwe bvunza kuti mutsara unoenderera munzira yemutsara wapfuura here kana kuti unopesana nayo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 unoshanduka kubva pakubatsira (mutsara 2) uchienda kudambudziko, asi chibatanidzi chawo chinowedzera zvakafanana. Izwi rekupesana rinodiwa ipapo. Mitsara 4 ne 5 inopa mugumisiro nemhedziso nemazvo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.prompt: Chibatanidzi chipi chinofanira kutsiva izwi rekutanga remutsara iwoyo?
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.0: Taura muchiRungu kuti mutsara une hukama hwakadini nemutsara wapfuura.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.1: Edza sarudzo imwe neimwe mumutsara uye ucherechedze kuti mitsara miviri ichiri kunzwisisika pamwe chete here.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvaizoti dambudziko mugumisiro wekubatsira, izvo zvisinganzwisisiki.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.b: Dambudziko harisi muenzaniso wekubatsira kuri mumutsara 2.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.explain: Ndima inofamba kubva pakubatsira kuenda kudambudziko, saka chibatanidzi chinofanira kuratidza kupesana.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara une kukanganisa nechibatanidzi chinokodzera (chengeta mutsara wose). Wobva wawedzera mutsara UMWE wako unotanga neizwi remugumisiro (semuenzaniso 그래서 kana 따라서) unobva padambudziko.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tsiva izwi rekutanga chete remutsara une kukanganisa.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.1: Pamutsara mutsva, bvunza: nokuda kwedambudziko iri, makambani anoitei kana kuda chii?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Chibatanidzi changu chitsva chinoratidza kushanduka kubva pakubatsira kuenda kudambudziko here?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mutsara wangu wekuwedzera unobva chaizvo padambudziko, kwete pakubatsira here?

n-k-k9-05.title: Kuudza ambuya nezvemutengo webhazi
n-k-k9-05.topic: Nhau kuChiKorea chinotaurwa chaambuya (nyora patsva kuvateereri)
n-k-k9-05.goal: Nyora patsva mutsara wenhau muChiKorea chine mutsa chinotaurwa chaambuya vemakore 68 uchichengeta zvakajeka, zvakangorongwa chete, uye zvinoshanda kwaari.
n-k-k9-05.material:
'Waverenga chinyorwa chenhau ichi pafoni yako. Ambuya vako (68) vanogara newe uye vanotora bhazi zuva rega rega. Havaverengi nhau.

[기사] 시는 다음 달 1일부터 시내버스 기본요금을 1,500원에서 1,700원으로 200원 인상할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 다만 만 65세 이상 어르신의 요금은 현행 1,500원으로 유지된다.'
n-k-k9-05.thinking.0: Kuchinja nzira yekutaura nesarudzo yemazwi kumuteereri mutsva
n-k-k9-05.thinking.1: Kuchengeta zvokwadi nemamiriro azvo (zvakarongwa, hazvisati zvaitwa) pakudzokorora
n-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Unoziva 존댓말 pamberi pemhando yekunyora yenhau
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: Uchaudza ambuya vako nenzwi. Kudzokorora kupi kwaizokanganisa nhau?
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga chinyorwa kamwe wobva warondedzera zvokwadi zvacho (riini, zvakadii, ndiani anobhadhara chii, zvakajeka sei). Wobva watarisa chokwadi chimwe nechimwe pakudzokorora kwega kwega.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kudzokorora apo chimwe chezvokwadi zvawarondedzera chisipo kana chakadzorerwa shure.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.a: Mutengo webhazi uchakwira 200 won mwedzi unotevera, asi kwete kuvakuru.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinochengeta hurongwa, huwandu nekusasanganisira, saka zvakatendeseka.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.b: Mutengo webhazi uchakwira 200 won mwedzi unotevera kuvose.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.c: Kubva mwedzi unotevera vakuru vanoramba vachibhadhara 1,500 won; vamwe vanobhadhara 200 won yakawanda.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakatendeseka uye zvinoisa chikamu chevakuru pamberi.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.d: Guta rinoti mutengo uchakwira ne200 won kubva mwedzi unotevera.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvakatendeseka: zvinochengeta kuti ndiani akazvitaura uye kuti chichiri hurongwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.explain: Chinyorwa chinoti mutengo wakarongwa kukwira mwedzi unotevera uye kuti vanhu vemakore 65 nekupfuura vanochengeta mutengo wekare. Shanduro yakakanganiswa inoti kukwira kunoshanda kuvose, saka inodonhedza kusasanganisira kunokosha kuna ambuya vako.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Mutsara upi wekutanga unokodzera kutaura kuna ambuya vako?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa zviperero zvemitsara: zvipi zvedhesiki renhau uye zvipi zveimba yemhuri?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti chiito izwi rezuva nezuva here kana izwi renyaya.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.b: Uku kuchiri kuzivisa nenzira yenhau uye kwakaoma kwazvo kutaura kwemhuri.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.c: Chiperero chakajairika chisina mutemo hachina kuremekedza ambuya, uye -니까 inonzwika isina moyo murefu.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.d: '인상되오니 … 바랍니다' mutauro webhodhi rezvizivisiro, uye unotaura kukwira sechinhu chakasarudzwa panzvimbo yekushumwa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.explain: Kutaura kwemhuri kumukuru kune mutsa asi kunyoro (-요), kunoshandisa mazwi ezuva nezuva (오르다 panzvimbo ye인상되다) uye -대요 inoshuma zvakataurwa nemumwe.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.prompt: Zvino udze ambuya vako nemashoko ako echiKorea: mitsara miviri zvakawanda, kutaura kwemutsa -요, pasina zviperero zvenhau. Chengeta zuva, huwandu, kuti chakangorongwa chete, uye zvinoshanda kwaari.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.0: Mutsara wekutanga: riini, zvakadii, uye kuti ihurongwa. Mutsara wechipiri: zvinoreva kwaari.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tsiva izwi rega rega renhau neizwi raungashandisa patafura yekudya.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shanduro yangu inoti here kuti kukwira kwakangorongwa chete?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ambuya vangu vaizoziva here kuti ivo pachavo vanobhadhara zvakafanana?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Mazwi angu ndiwo andaizotaura kumba chaizvo here?
